ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SayRam needs microphone access to record your voice notes.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SayRam needs speech recognition to turn what you say into text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SayRam reads your photo library to show previews of photos you attach to a schedule. Photos are never copied or sent anywhere.
ios.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Allow alarms so your schedule alarms ring like the Clock app, even in Silent or Focus mode.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: When you say “send it to Mom”, SayRam looks up that person’s number in your contacts to fill in the text message. Contacts never leave this phone.
